name: notes_search

variables.kept: where notes are kept and which are searched (", global or this project's; both are searched"), or empty

description: Search your notes: things worth keeping that are longer than a memory entry and not a skill — findings, a design worked out with the user, a list to come back to. Kept across sessions{{kept}}. An empty query lists the newest. Read one with note_view; write with note_manage.
